verdict.rationale: Steel documents exporting agent-trace runs in open formats (markdown, JSON, a ZIP with screenshots), and its open-source steel-browser with a pre-built Docker image provides a self-hosted exit path. Export is only documented for trace data, not for all account data. Missing for 10: a documented full account or data export (sessions, profiles, files, credentials), a stated data portability or offboarding process, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Copy the run as markdown, download JSON, or grab a ZIP with markdown plus screenshots.
Steel is an open source browser API that lets you control fleets of browsers in the cloud.
